name: Futureswap governance in-transaction snapshot flash-loan vote
summary: Futureswap's Ethereum governance implementation takes the FST voting snapshot inside createProposal - it calls FST.snapshot() in the proposer's own transaction - and accepts votes weighted by balanceOfAt(voter, thatSnapshot) in the same transaction. Because ERC20Snapshot records the balance held at snapshot time, FST borrowed through a Uniswap V2 flash swap counted as voting power and was repaid in the same transaction, clearing the ~10%-of-supply pass threshold that the proposer's own 12,166.89 FST could not. The passed proposal made the governance executor grant the attacker wallet access in the Registry, and the attacker drained the Futureswap Wallet's 79.41 WETH and 315,981.63 USDC. A second actor repeated the same flash vote in January 2026 to take ownership of the executor and drained further Futureswap holdings on Ethereum and, through a cross-chain ownership message, on Avalanche.

loss.notes: Gross victim depletion across two merged campaigns of the same flash-vote defect. Campaign 1 (0xcd7c839c..., 2025-12-16, $550,740.77): the Futureswap Wallet 0xd1ed35a3ee043683a1833509de8f2c1a0d8777b7 lost its entire 79.405596790744422188 WETH (unwrapped and forwarded as ETH) and its entire 315,981.629985453558859560 FSDPT, redeemed for 315,981.62972 USDC paid to the attacker. Campaign 2 (0x81801a4e..., 2026-01-10, $52,969.63): Ethereum stETH and WETH from Futureswap holding contracts 0x173181d00c9af20497fe692b7ecbb62aeab801b9 and 0x9fc1c67246f8c047d72760b4d29ef7247026db9a, 0.49991228 ETH from messenger 0xb36ea7b5ec29afc1b05fe22b5420e4faae149caf, 0.524163232103428489 WETH extracted from the FST/WETH Uniswap V2 pair by selling 1e12 FST minted through the captured executor, and Avalanche USDC, WAVAX and JOE from three Futureswap contracts after a cross-chain transferOwnership. Excluded: the 31,826.29 DAI the second attacker received on Ethereum (bridge proceeds of the Avalanche USDC, not additional loss), attacker-paid messaging fees and flash-swap fees, and FST holder dilution. Reports cite about $500k (Verichains, campaign 1) and $830k (Cryptopolitan, basis unstated).

ageReset.description: The TransparentUpgradeableProxy constructor selected governance implementation 0x1b4a6853ad879b3788f22bf2d54902cb1bdf09d7 and initialized it with FST. This is the only pre-exploit Upgraded event; the next one (2026-01-08, to attacker-deployed 0x838a422125ece1bea0e6c2c540041799df1c1c1a) postdates both campaigns' governance votes.

limitations: The governance implementation is unverified; the defect is established from execution traces, the proposal struct, bytecode selectors and a fork replay rather than source code.

FST proxy 0x0e192d382a36de7011f795acc4391cd302003606 (implementation 0x983b8032c76b671c4a1c4cab235c5d32e184516c since 2022-02-11) is not a target: its ERC20Snapshot records balances as designed, and the 2022 upgrade from verified FsToken 0x5264847bd5b5f182254e830e2d63088d50bba90e only replaced burnFromAccount(address,uint256) with burnFst(), leaving snapshot()/balanceOfAt unchanged, so the flash-vote combination existed from the governance deployment.

sources.note: Anchor and root cause (Ethereum, eth_getTransactionReceipt + debug_traceTransaction callTracer). 0x23c6a1e3... block 24012462 idx 104, from 0xcd7c839c... (nonce 19) to attacker contract 0xbc59f04f...: UniswapV2 FST/WETH pair 0x88ae9e16... swap (0x022c0d9f) sends 3,599,999.99999999983222784 FST (log 0xb5); in the callback 0xbc59 calls governance proxy 0x0a7f8161... (EIP-1967 impl slot 0x360894a1... = 0x1b4a6853... at block 24012461) createProposal 0x91097889(executor 0xd25ecaface..., [Registry 0x3659ae5f...], [addWalletAccess(0xbc59...) 0x35f0b915...], 'stETH/WETH Ethereum Exchange'); inside it the governance CALLs FST.snapshot() 0x9711715a (returns 0x35=53; Snapshot log 0xb8) then transferFrom(0xbc59, gov, 100 FST) (log 0xb9). vote(8,true) (0xc9d27afe) STATICCALLs FST.balanceOfAt(0xbc59,53) -> 3,600,297.601766914567922566 FST (Vote log 0xbc); the flash amount plus fee (3,610,832.497 FST) returns to the pair (log 0xc2). A second contract 0xced83c86 votes with weight 0 (log 0xbe). FST's ERC20Snapshot (verified FsToken 0x5264847bd5b5f182254e830e2d63088d50bba90e: snapshot() increments the id; _transfer calls _updateAccountSnapshot before the balance change; balanceOfAt returns the current balance when unrecorded) values the snapshot at the holder's balance at snapshot time, so flash-borrowed FST becomes permanent voting weight. Pass rule, anvil fork at block 24012461: proposal from the EOA with its own 12,166.893696 FST -> resolve(8) after 172,900 s emits 0xd92fba44 and Registry.hasWalletAccess(0xbc59)=false; 3,474,000 FST pre-transferred -> same rejection; 3,475,000 FST -> WalletAccessAdded + ProposalExecuted, i.e. yes >= ~10% of totalSupply 34,746,557.921367832658812792 FST; minimumVoteTime()=172800. proposals(8) at block 24026875: proposer 0xbc59, snapshot 53, yes 0x2fa6486298cc9e96b6386, no 0. Earliest: governance logs (Etherscan getLogs, 182 rows) hold ProposalCreated 0-7 on 2021-10-10..2022-09-06, sent directly by EOAs 0x40b17338.../0x4835b48f... in 4-log receipts with no pair transfer, then #8 in this tx; the attacker's 18 earlier successful txs (2025-12-13..14) create no proposal or vote (Wallet probes with self-minted tokens, flash-swap test 0x7b9032fc...). resolve(8) 0x761f0286... block 24026876 idx 135: executor.execute -> Registry.addWalletAccess(0xbc59) (log 0x137), ProposalExecuted(8) (log 0x139); hasWalletAccess(0xbc59) false at 24026875, true at 24026876. Registry.getWalletAddress() = 0xd1ed35a3... Classification: the snapshot-in-proposer-transaction and same-transaction vote is a code defect; the exploit relied on flash-borrowed, not owned, FST. Context: at block 24012461 the pair held 5,286,660.24 FST / 0.805342799546 WETH and DefiLlama priced FST at $0.00047, so buying the quorum outright would also have been cheap. Target identity: in 0x23c6a1e3... the governance proxy 0x0a7f8161605acc552fa38fdb8ee7d8177c9ac22a DELEGATECALLs 0x1b4a6853ad879b3788f22bf2d54902cb1bdf09d7 for createProposal (0x91097889), vote (0xc9d27afe) and, in 0x761f0286..., resolve (0x4f896d4f). keccak(eth_getCode(0x1b4a...)) = 0x76f29619b0a87bffda9c908be19c063600f9c2acb74511ed997739c0a3462f2a at blocks 13366312 and 24012461. The implementation was created by 0x2df537ba... in 0xe964c778... (block 13366307). Its dispatcher includes proposals(uint256) 0x013cf08b, resolve 0x4f896d4f, veto 0x1d28dec7, votingToken 0xb0340123, proposalFstStake 0xdc8de58a (returns 100 FST) and minimumVoteTime 0xfbc38145 (returns 172800). Age: proxy 0x0a7f created top-level by 0x2df537bab848f26047461716768791e68bba27d7 in 0x8fe815b2... block 13366312 idx 39 (status 1); eth_getCode at block 13366311 is 0x; the constructor emits Upgraded(0x1b4a...) at log 27, AdminChanged at log 29, and the initializer sets FST 0x0e192d38... as the voting token. Etherscan getLogs for topic0 0xbc7cd75a... on 0x0a7f returns only this log and 0x48b2516b... (block 24191389, 2026-01-08, to attacker-deployed 0x838a4221...), and the implementation slot equals 0x1b4a... at block 24012461. Campaign 2's vote (block 24177029) and resolve (block 24191384) also ran on 0x1b4a before that upgrade. The proxy runtime hash 0x9017c68fd847e47d06b0c733a739f0e9f032f07343dd67c94deb99bd28347cea is the same at blocks 13366312 and 24012461. codeAgeSeconds = 1765734803 - 1633535276 = 132199527.

limitations: Campaign 2 holdings contracts on Ethereum and Avalanche are unverified; they are attributed to Futureswap because they honoured transfer calls from the captured executor or governance-owned proxies, not from project documentation.

The 0.524163232103428489 WETH taken from the FST/WETH pair comes from selling FST minted through the captured executor; it is LP depletion caused by the takeover rather than a Futureswap treasury balance.
